Name: CGA Prairie King
Author: TheLimeyDragon
Description:
This is a simple recolour of the Prairie King mini game with the style of the  white/cyan/magenta/black and yellow/green/red/black CGA colour palettes. It also includes a monochrome black/white version. It should work on all the default language versions

Maybe one day I will include changed music that changes it to a single voice square wave.

There are a couple of minor things I don't think I can change the colour of and one thing (the clock) is used elsewhere and I don't think people want that changed everywhere.
